name: coolify-mcp
description: Inspect a self-hosted Coolify instance: servers, projects, applications, databases, services, and health. Mostly read-only, with restart and redeploy actions.
long_description: Gives Claude visibility into a self-hosted Coolify instance: servers, projects, applications, databases, and one-click services, plus recent application logs and an instance health check. Three narrow write actions are included — restart_application, restart_service, and trigger_deployment — all of which only re-run existing configuration (equivalent to the Restart/Deploy buttons in the Coolify UI). No config edits, no create/delete, no stop actions are exposed.

coolify_base_url.title: Coolify Base URL
coolify_base_url.description: The URL of your Coolify instance, e.g. http://localhost:8000 or https://coolify.example.com (no trailing slash).

coolify_api_token.title: Coolify API Token
coolify_api_token.description: API token generated in Coolify under Settings > API Tokens. Stored securely in your OS keychain.
